left.title: McConnell backs bill to ease up on hemp cultivation
left.body: Mitch McConnell will introduce legislation to allow states to regulate their own hemp industries, a move that could be a boon to the Senate majority leader should he pursue reelection in 2020.
left.roundup: Republican Sen. Mitch McConnell announced he will introduce a bill to legalize hemp as an agricultural commodity, removing it from the federal list of controlled substances.

center.title: McConnell bill would legalize hemp as agricultural product
center.body: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell (R-Ky.) announced a new bill on Monday that would legalize hemp as an agricultural product.
center.roundup: Republican Sen. Mitch McConnell announced he will introduce a bill to legalize hemp as an agricultural commodity, removing it from the federal list of controlled substances.

right.title: Mitch McConnell will introduce a bill to greenlight hemp production
right.body: Sen. Mitch McConnell, the Republican majority leader from Kentucky, is promoting new legislation to legalize hemp and remove it from the list of controlled substances.
right.roundup: Republican Sen. Mitch McConnell announced he will introduce a bill to legalize hemp as an agricultural commodity, removing it from the federal list of controlled substances.
